The '''snow shovel''' is an iron shovel variant that clears snow very quickly but digs everything else very slowly.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==
It mines snow, snow blocks and powder snow at speed 15 and other shovel blocks at speed {{Value|Snow Shovel|miningspeed}}, with {{Value|Snow Shovel|durability}} durability. It deals {{Value|Snow Shovel|damage|format=raw}} damage at speed {{Value|Snow Shovel|attackspeed}} and is repaired with iron ingots.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/snow_shovel.json}}</ref> Its tooltip shows mining speed 1.
